salary_details.details: While on deputation, officers may elect to draw either the pay in the scale of pay of the post in KDS, SMPK or their basic pay in the parent organization plus deputation allowance (5% or 10% of basic pay subject to ceilings). Cafeteria allowance up to 35% of Basic Pay is applicable if opting for the KDS pay scale. HRA is payable at rates prevailing in Kolkata Dock System, SMPA.

selection_process: The selection process is based on deputation / absorption from amongst eligible officers from Major Port Authorities
satisfying the provisions of the Recruitment Rules
along with verification of ACRs/APARs and required certificates.
how_to_apply: Download the official notification and application pro-forma (Annexure-III) from the official website www.smportkolkata.shipping.gov.in.
Fill out the application form with all required details in block letters.
Affix self-attested passport size photographs on the application form.
Attach certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each page.
Attach attested copies of educational qualification certificates, work experience certificates, and administrative/no-objection certificate (Annexure-IV).
Enclose the applicant undertaking regarding non-withdrawal of candidature and vigilance clearance certificate (Annexure-V).
Superscribe the envelope as "Application for the post of Dy Personnel Officer on deputation / absorption basis".
Forward the application through proper channel to the Secretary, Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Kolkata, 15, Strand Road, Kolkata-700001 on or before 30 October 2026.
important_instructions: The crucial date for determining eligibility is 30 October 2026. Deputation will be initially for three (03) years, further extendable by 02 more years. If advance copies are sent, the application through proper channel must reach within 15 days of the last date, i.e., by 14 November 2026. Incomplete applications or those received after the due date will be rejected. If any major or minor penalty has been imposed during the last 10 years, disciplinary details and CVC-format vigilance report must be sent by the forwarding authority. Pay scale granted as financial up-gradation under MACPS should not be indicated as regular service in the grade.

content_sections.heading: SMP SMP Dy Personnel Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is based on deputation / absorption from amongst eligible officers from Major Port Authorities, satisfying the provisions of the Recruitment Rules, along with verification of ACRs/APARs and required certificates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SMP SMP Dy Personnel Officer
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and application pro-forma (Annexure-III) from the official website www.smportkolkata.shipping.gov.in . Fill out the application form with all required details in block letters. Affix self-attested passport size photographs on the application form. Attach certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each page. Attach attested copies of educational qualification certificates, work experience certificates, and administrative/no-objection certificate (Annexure-IV). Enclose the applicant undertaking regarding non-withdrawal of candidature and vigilance clearance certificate (Annexure-V). Superscribe the envelope as "Application for the post of Dy Personnel Officer on deputation / absorption basis". Forward the application through proper channel to the Secretary, Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Kolkata, 15, Strand Road, Kolkata-700001 on or before 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (attested by Dy. HOD) Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Proof of present and past work experience with regularisation details if applicable Administrative / No Objection Certificate from the competent authority (Annexure-IV) Applicant undertaking not to withdraw candidature if selected Vigilance comments / clearance certificate in the prescribed pro-forma (Annexure-V) Two self-attested passport size photographs

content_sections.heading: SMP SMP Dy Personnel Officer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The crucial date for determining eligibility is 30 October 2026. Deputation will be initially for three (03) years, further extendable by 02 more years. If advance copies are sent, the application through proper channel must reach within 15 days of the last date, i.e., by 14 November 2026. Incomplete applications or those received after the due date will be rejected. If any major or minor penalty has been imposed during the last 10 years, disciplinary details and CVC-format vigilance report must be sent by the forwarding authority. Pay scale granted as financial up-gradation under MACPS should not be indicated as regular service in the grade.

faq.question: Q1. What is SMP SMP Dy Personnel Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Kolkata to fill 2 posts of Dy Personnel Officer under LA&IR Division of General Administration Department (total 3 posts at Kolkata Dock System) on a deputation/absorption basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies notified for the post of Dy Personnel Officer at Kolkata Dock System.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 30 October 2026. Applications through proper channel must be received by 14 November 2026 in case of advance copies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in any discipline from a recognized university/institution along with five years experience in executive cadre in General Administration, Personnel & Industrial Relations in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking, or hold analogous posts in Major Port Authorities.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for Dy Personnel Officer?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the IDA Pattern Scale of Pay of Rs. 50,000 - 1,60,000/- (Pre-revised Rs. 20,600 - 46,500/-).
